scope: Read-only recorded-state integrity, goal outcome and independent geometric quality. No solver, trajectory, legacy threshold or observation changes.

research.reason: Existing task outcome thresholds are inherited unchanged from cutting_tasks_v1.json. Surface precision is measured separately and is not a universal task goal. Custom research limits must be explicitly declared in GoalSpec before evaluation.

missing_surface: Unknown mesh intersection; never a measured zero height, zero error or physical gouge. All ray locations, values and masks are exported. Paired statistics are explicitly conditional and have no whole-region PASS when coverage is unknown.
reference_targets: Analytic and independently frozen represented targets are reported separately; no fitted registration or output-dependent target adjustment.

roi.source: Predeclared geometry diagnostic only, never an exclusion from whole-object quality
